name: Zambia
famous_for: Victoria Falls ('Mosi-oa-Tunya' - The Smoke That Thunders), Devil's Pool swimming on the waterfall edge, and South Luangwa safari.
tourists: Over 1.2M safari visitors; famous for Victoria Falls bridge bungee, walking safaris in South Luangwa, and Lower Zambezi canoeing.
must_know: Zambia pioneered the concept of the walking safari in South Luangwa, allowing travelers to track elephants and leopards on foot with armed guides.
fun_fact: Victoria Falls is one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World, forming the largest sheet of falling water on the planet.
